title: How Ar-Raʿd is built
standfirst: A map of the sūrah before you read it: six movements, the āyāt where an occasion is reported, and the words it repeats most. Every line jumps into the text.

movements.label: The world as proof
movements.note: The Book is true, and then the sūrah points at the sky, the mountains, the rivers, the fruit and the night — things already saying something.

entries.title: Mountains, rivers, two kinds of fruit

movements.label: Dust raised, and the record
movements.note: They call it strange that dust should be raised. The answer is knowledge that misses nothing, down to the two angels keeping the record.

entries.title: Why they are not punished at once
A people does not change until…

movements.label: Weather, then the flood
movements.note: Lightning and thunder, then rain, valleys, foam — and the verdict on what is left behind.

entries.title: The flood, the metal, the foam

movements.label: Two kinds of people
movements.note: Those who keep the covenant, join what was ordered joined, are patient, spend, and answer evil with good — set against those who break it.

entries.title: Who responds, and who does not
The one who knows, the one who is blind

movements.label: The word they would not write
movements.note: The āyah tied to Ḥudaybiyyah, and the name Suhayl refused.

movements.label: Closing
movements.note: The garden described, the erasing and the confirming, and the Book's own witness.

entries.title: He was a man with a family

occasions.title: The keys of the Unseen
occasions.who: Concerning knowledge of the Hour, and the five things in 31:34.

occasions.title: The guards who take turns
occasions.who: Angels who succeed one another, meeting at Fajr and ʿAṣr.

occasions.title: What the thunder is
occasions.who: An angel driving the clouds, with fire in his hand.

occasions.title: The name they would not write
occasions.who: Suhayl ibn ʿAmr at Ḥudaybiyyah, refusing the name al-Raḥmān.

occasions.title: The recitation that moves mountains
occasions.who: The famous ʿUmm ʿAṭāʾ report — weak, and not used as proof here.

occasions.title: He was a man with a family
occasions.who: A group who came to ask why the Prophet ﷺ ate food and married.

occasions.title: Erasing and confirming
occasions.who: A story from the Ḥudaybiyyah period that the sound reports do not carry.
